runtimeExposureRule: This registry is a build-time contract. It lives under docs/architecture/ so that nothing under src/ can import it, and scripts/checkContentConsistency.mjs fails if any src/ module references this path or if a public lab or technique JSON serializes a sourceTrace object. Source-trace data must never reach client-visible lab state.
policy: Every new or modified physical action in a source-derived owner needs an entry here: which dated plan it comes from, which table that step lives in, which step or confirmation point, and the M/F/R/C basis. A compound basis such as M/F or R/C is recorded verbatim; it is never simplified to a single letter. A C basis means the behaviour must stay teacher-configurable or blocked, never decided by an implementation cycle.

sourceTableLegend.phase: A procedure-phase table (`ID | Atomic student action | Basis | ...`). It has an explicit Basis column, copied here verbatim.
sourceTableLegend.apparatus: An apparatus-assembly table (`State | Atomic action | Resulting composite | Validation | Asset disposition`). It has NO Basis column, so citing one as `M` would assert the manual states that exact step. An apparatus row is table-supported: its basis must include `F`, compounded with any marker the row carries inline. The content checker enforces this. Prefer a phase row whenever one states the same step.
sourceTableLegend.safety: A source safety table (`ID | Atomic student action | Safety behavior | Local recovery | ...`). Its explicit row identifier and basis are copied into the citation so a safety S-08 cannot be confused with a procedure-phase S-08.

crossTableStepIdentifiersPolicy: A dated plan may reuse one step identifier in two of its tables. `sourceTableLegend` already treats the table as part of a row's identity; this list is where that split is declared so the citation-identity check can tell two rows apart from one row cited inconsistently. Declaring a split never relaxes the basis comparison inside either row.

crossTableStepIdentifiers.rationale: The plan carries two different S-08 rows. Safety S-08 (M/C) is the waste neutralisation: `ap-chem-lab-manual-student-inv-2.pdf`, printed page 27, Safety -- "The remaining brass solution should be neutralized by adding small amounts of solid baking soda until the bubbling has subsided and the pH is 5-9" (M), disposed of "as directed by your instructor" (C). Procedure-phase S-08 (M) is "Record absorbance", printed page 28, step 7. They are separate rows with separate bases, not one row transcribed two ways.

contextTracePolicy.policy: A context trace points to the nearest named source operation for context only. Its basis and sourceBasis copy the original source-row basis verbatim; actionBasis describes the inferred, real-life, or configured action. mappingRationale explains the mapping. Legacy direct rows retain their existing shape and basis.
